name: intent-to-behavior-review
description: Model intended software behavior and find evidence-backed logic defects.

interface.shortDescription: Find logic gaps between intent and behavior.
interface.longDescription: Reconstruct intended application behavior, compare it with implementation and history, then validate semantic and logic defects with focused evidence and deterministic Python probes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this feature by modeling its intended behavior before comparing the implementation and history.
